newsitem.title: UK: UK's Knight says run of low inflation continues.
newsitem.headline: UK's Knight says run of low inflation continues.

text.p: The British Treasury's economic secretary, Angela Knight, said on Thursday that Britain's long run of sustained low inflation was continuing, following release of data on August retail price inflation.
"Our long run of sustained low inflation continues. Britain is now getting the low-inflation habit," Knight said in a statement quoted by a British Tresaury official.

The comments follow data showing August retail prices rose 0.5 percent in the month and were up 2.1 percent from a year earlier. This compared with a 0.4 percent decline and 2.2 percent year-on-year growth in July.
The numbers were near forecasts for an August monthly rise of 0.4 percent and matched the year-on-year expectation for a 2.1 percent gain.
